title: Affirmative defense, MCA TITLE 45 CHAPTER 5 Part 7 45-5-710 Affirmative defense Montana Code Annotated 2025 TITLE 45
subsections: CRIMES CHAPTER 5. OFFENSES AGAINST THE PERSON Part 7. Human Trafficking Affirmative Defense 45-5-710. Affirmative defense. A person charged with prostitution, sex trafficking or prior similar laws in effect at the time the act occurred, or another nonviolent offense committed as a direct result of being a victim of human trafficking may assert an affirmative defense that the person is a victim of human trafficking.
